5078-6633-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1339-2425-2511.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2425-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

728-2178-4681-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 4.
728-2178-4681-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

222-527-1115-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1115-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-1115-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-3845-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

849-2738-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Anax, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1495-4120-7803.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4120-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1495-4120-7803.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-4120-7803.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

1263-1417-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

1849-3259-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
1849-3259-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7754--167.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the other Mutant.
When the Mutant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Mutant enters, X-23 triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on X-23 and the other Mutant.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
5147-6972-7754--167.notes: The chosen Mutant must have toughness 2 or greater.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-5921-5970-7730.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

997-3240-5477-6462.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token, a 1/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-5073-6972.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

1394-2060-3129-5231-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Primal Vigor.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Primal Vigor.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-4659-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

147-2921-3440.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

586-5258-5618-6797-6967.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

413-3781-4191--122.description:
Cast the Insect from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast the Insect from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Zask ability, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

3525-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues.
3525-3918-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

1251-2615-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
1251-2615-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

225-2783-2972-6455.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G} or have a basic Forest in your library.
225-2783-2972-6455.description:
Cast Encroaching Dragonstorm by paying {3}{G}.
When Encroaching Dragonstorm enters, it first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Nesting Dragon trigger twice.
Resolve the first Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land that can produce {G}.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve a Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Ganax and Encroaching Dragonstorm's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Encroaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat

618-5231-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token, adding {R}.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

440-1339-2034-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
440-1339-2034-6458.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-6458.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

5670-5708-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-5708-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2829-3908-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2829-3908-5365.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Spark Double's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spark Double.
Spark Double's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.
2829-3908-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

851-4050-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
851-4050-5189-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1844-6085-6086-6087.notablePrerequisites:
Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
Your deck size is at least 7.
1844-6085-6086-6087.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying {3}{B}, causing you to draw seven cards and give control of Altanak to an opponent.
Declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Altanak to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2233-5360-5620.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Cleansing Fire has at least two indestructible counters on it.
Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2233-5360-5620.description:
Activate Myojin of Cleansing Fire by removing an indestructible counter from it, destroying each other creature.
When Park Heights Maverick dies, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cleansing Fire and Myojin of Grim Betrayal.
Activate Myojin of Grim Betrayal by removing an indestructible counter from it, putting Park Heights Maverick and any other creature that died this turn from each player's graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

618-3419-4613.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nonlegendary Human creature.
You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and that does not have summoning sickness.
618-3419-4613.description:
Activate a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary Human creature you control with haste that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Dearly Departed.
Repeat.

2034-3821-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
2034-3821-5003.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, adding {C}{C}.
When Peregrine Drake dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
If the lands can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1020-1117-2034-2906.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
1020-1117-2034-2906.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
Junk Diver dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying at most {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying at most {2}.
Repeat.

364-813-1987-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.

738-3370-3652-4659.description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding {C}{C}.
Butcher of Malakir triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Ornithopter to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
